### `schemas/configuration/windows-event-log-source.schema.json`

Channel subscriptions with explicit event ID allow-lists, each mapped by one signed pack parser (BOWER_WINDOWS_EVENTLOG_CONFIG, C# collector on Windows only). The collector generates the Windows query; there is no free-text query or collect-all form.

Required fields: `apiVersion`, `kind`, `subscriptions`.

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `apiVersion` | `object` | Yes |  |
| `kind` | `object` | Yes |  |
| `subscriptions` | `array` | Yes |  |

### `schemas/packs/pack-sample.schema.json`

One line of a pack samples/*.jsonl file, version 2. Version 2 adds expectFields and parser names; every version 1 line (event or raw samples with decision, mustNotContain and expectedDetections) is a valid version 2 line. Editor support only: PackTester is authoritative and also rejects unknown or duplicated members, duplicate expectFields paths and expectations that name a pre-redaction value.

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | No | Shown in test output and reports. Defaults to sample-N. |
| `expect` | `object` | No | Expected decision. accept also passes for redact-and-accept; redact-and-accept requires redaction. |
| `event` | `object` | No | A semantic security event envelope. {{now}} is replaced with the current UTC time. |
| `raw` | `object` | No | A raw record for a pack parser (parse, transform, map, redact, select). {{now}} is replaced with the current UTC time, which is also the transform evaluation time. |
| `rawLines` | `array` | No | Physical text lines merged through the parser's multiline rule before parsing, transform, redaction and selection. {{now}} is replaced with the current UTC time. |
| `expectEvents` | `integer` | No | Exact number of merged events expected from rawLines. Defaults to 1 when rawLines is used. |
| `parser` | `object` | No | Parser for a raw sample: zero-based index in manifest (ordinal path) order, or a parser name (file name without extension, or its pack path). |
| `mustNotContain` | `array` | No | Strings that must not appear anywhere in the redacted event. |
| `expectedDetections` | `array` | No | Exact set of local detection rule ids expected on the redacted event. |
| `expectFields` | `object` | No | Post-redaction field assertions: path to "present", "absent" (missing or null) or an exact string, finite number or boolean. A string that equals a pre-redaction value missing from the redacted event, or contains a mustNotContain entry, fails without being printed. |

| `suppression` | `object` | No | Admit at most allowPerWindow accepted events per key in each epoch-aligned window; count the rest and report them in one telemetry_aggregation_summary event per window. With decision action aggregate, allowPerWindow is 0 or omitted and every matching event is only counted. Not allowed with neverSample, non-accepting actions or the summary event type. A policy set that suppresses or aggregates must also accept telemetry_aggregation_summary. |

### `schemas/privacy-profile.schema.json`

Privacy profile for the Privacy & Secret Protection Engine (kind: PrivacyProfile). Editor support only: the loader is authoritative and also rejects unknown keys, invalid custom detector patterns and failing custom detector tests.

Required fields: `apiVersion`, `kind`, `metadata`.

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `apiVersion` | `object` | Yes |  |
| `kind` | `object` | Yes |  |
| `metadata` | `object` | Yes |  |
| `defaultAction` | `object` | No |  |
| `detectors` | `object` | No | Built-in detector action overrides. Custom detectors set their action in customDetectors. |
| `disabled` | `array` | No | Built-in or custom detector ids to switch off. |
| `enableOptIn` | `array` | No | Opt-in built-in detectors to switch on (custom detectors are always on unless disabled). |
| `fields` | `array` | No |  |
| `maximumFieldLength` | `integer` | No |  |
| `emitMetadata` | `boolean` | No |  |
| `customDetectors` | `array` | No |  |
| `secretFieldNames` | `array` | No | Extra field names removed like built-in field-name secrets. Compared after normalisation (letters and digits only, lower-cased), so sessionKey also covers session_key and SESSION-KEY. |

### `schemas/tap/tap-frame.schema.json`

The data of one 'frame' server-sent event from GET /v1/tap (bower tap). Post-redaction only: 'event' is the exact redacted queued payload of an accepted event; every other outcome is metadata only and carries 'eventOmitted'.

Required fields: `schemaVersion`, `sequence`, `observedAt`, `stage`, `action`, `queued`, `duplicate`, `suppressed`, `eventType`, `application`, `environment`, `policyId`, `reasons`.
